item.title: Peter Obi Joins National Assembly Protest To Demand Mandatory Real-Time Election Results Transmission
item.description: Peter Obi joins protesters demanding Electoral Act amendment to mandate real-time electronic transmission of results ahead of 2027 elections.

item.title: Electoral Act Delay May Compromise 2027 Polls, CSOs Warn Senate
item.description: Civil society groups urge National Assembly to mandate real time electronic result transmission to safeguard 2027 elections credibility.

item.title: NCC Commits To Strengthening West Africa Digital Ties, Promises Regional Telecom Collaboration
item.description: NCC pledges closer cooperation with regional regulators to boost digital integration and improve cross-border connectivity in West Africa.

item.title: Senate Defends N25.91trn 2026 Deficit, Pushes Full Electricity Subsidy Removal
item.description: Senate defends N25.91trn 2026 deficit, says borrowing necessary to fund 2026 budget, insists electricity subsidy must end to free resources.

item.title: NAFDAC Denies Banning Amoxicillin Amid Social Media Rumours
item.description: NAFDAC clarifies claims on Amoxicillin ban as false, urges Nigerians to rely on verified updates and safety alerts only.

item.title: Oba Of Benin Condemns Rising Killings, Backs Tinubu, Okpebholo’s Security Initiatives
item.description: Oba of Benin calls nationwide violence “worrisome and deeply depressing,” urges Nigerians to support government efforts to restore peace.

item.title: Senegal Police Bust 14 In Alleged France-Linked Transnational Paedophile Ring
item.description: Senegalese police have arrested 14 suspects in transnational paedophile ring linked to France, uncovering years of alleged abuse.

item.title: CJN: Nigeria’s Power Sector Undergoing Major Transformation
item.description: Justice Kekere-Ekun says reforms will expand judicial responsibilities, promote legal certainty, and attract investment in Nigeria’s electricity market.

item.title: Maurice Ibe: Nigeria Spent $25bn On Refineries, Nothing Works, No One Jailed
item.description: Oil and gas consultant Maurice Ibe says corruption turned NNPC refineries into political cash cows despite decades of spending.

item.title: Olawepo-Hashim: Nigeria’s Economy Has Collapsed Under APC, GDP Shrunk By Over 50%
item.description: Gbenga Olawepo-Hashim says policy failures, currency devaluation and insecurity have crippled production despite reform claims.
